info.title: mitch-risk API
info.description: REST API for mitch-risk — a lightweight third party vendor risk management solution. Supports two authentication methods: browser session cookies (log in via the web app) and API keys (generated in Settings → API). API keys use Bearer token authentication and must be enabled by an admin before they can be used. API keys grant full access to every endpoint and remain valid independently of the account that created them. Keys can be IP-restricted and have configurable expiry.

tags.name: Vendors

tags.name: Assessments

tags.name: Findings

get.description: Returns all vendors, optionally filtered by name/email search query or tier. Unauthenticated requests receive 401.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search across vendor name and contact email

200.description: List of vendors matching the criteria

get.description: Returns full vendor profile including contact info, scores, assessment history, and domain compliance breakdown.

put.description: Updates a vendor's details. All fields are optional — fields omitted from the request body retain their existing values.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a vendor and all associated assessments, responses, evidence, and findings. This action is irreversible.

get.description: Returns a lightweight score summary for a vendor — useful for dashboards and integrations.
Downloads a CSV file containing vendor details, assessment summaries, certifications, and customer responsibility actions. Suitable for spreadsheet import or backup.

post.description: Create a new vendor from a JSON body. The body must contain at minimum `name` and `contactEmail`.

400.description: Invalid input — missing fields or bad data

get.description: Returns audit trail entries with optional filters for activity type, user, date range, and pagination. Supports both JSON and CSV output. Rate-limited to 60/min per API key. 10 results per page.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Filter by audit action type (e.g. LOGIN, CREATE_VENDOR, PUBLISH_TEMPLATE)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format — JSON array or CSV download

get.description: Downloads a CSV file containing all responses (with compliance status) and findings for an assessment.
Generates and downloads a PDF report containing the assessment responses, score, findings, and vendor details. Branded with the organisation name.

Downloads a JSON file containing the template structure — sections, questions, types, weights, options, expected answers, conditional logic, and control mappings. Can be re-imported via the UI import form.
Returns paginated assessment list with optional filters: vendorId, status, fromDate, toDate, query. Supports JSON and CSV output.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search term to filter assessments by title

parameters.name: overdue
parameters.description: Set to 'true' to show only overdue assessments

200.description: Paginated list of assessments (JSON) or CSV download

get.description: Returns full assessment detail: vendor info, template, questions with responses, review decisions, findings, and threaded comments.
Returns all assessments for a specific vendor. Convenience shortcut for /v1/assessments?vendorId=X.
Returns all certifications for a vendor with attachment details.
Returns paginated findings across all vendors. Filter by status, severity, or vendorId.

patch.description: Transition a finding from OPEN to REMEDIATED or RISK_ACCEPTED. Cannot transition from already-closed states.

example.resolutionNote: Vendor has implemented the required control.

get.description: Returns all compliance frameworks with control counts.
Returns a framework with all its controls. Supports optional search query to filter controls by code, title, domain, or guidance.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search controls by text (code, title, domain, guidance)

delete.description: Permanently deletes a framework and all its controls. Template questions mapped to these controls lose their assignments. Existing assessments and findings are unaffected. Requires frameworks:delete permission.

get.description: Returns aggregated portfolio metrics: vendor counts, average score, RAG score distribution, vendor-by-tier counts, top 10 deficient controls, open findings count, and assessment status breakdown. No per-vendor PII — aggregation only.
Generates a PDF report covering all vendors in the portfolio. Includes overall risk summary, vendor score distribution, top findings, and responsibility tracking overview.

sessionCookie.name: authjs.session-token
sessionCookie.description: Auth.js session token cookie. Log in via `/login` in a browser to obtain one. Works automatically when calling from the browser.

bearerAuth.description: API key authentication. Generate keys in Settings → API. Keys have the form `mrk_<prefix>.<secret>`; use the full value in the `Authorization` header as `Bearer mrk_<prefix>.<secret>`. Keys grant full access to every endpoint and remain valid independently of the account that created them. Keys can be IP-restricted and have configurable expiry. API key auth must be enabled by an admin first.

Unauthorized.description: The request is missing valid authentication. Log in via the web app for a session cookie, or provide a valid API key via `Authorization: Bearer mrk_xxx`. API keys must be enabled by an admin (Settings → API).

Forbidden.description: The caller is authenticated but lacks the permission required for this endpoint. API keys can be scoped to specific permissions at creation (Settings → API); browser sessions inherit permissions from the user's assigned role. Ask an admin to grant the relevant permission (Settings → Roles).
